evidence.title: インスタ自動化ツールエルグラムがChatGPT向けアプリ公開、AI分析に対応
evidence.body: [e001:f01] 株式会社ミショナ（本社：福岡県福岡市、… 株式会社ミショナが提供するInstagram（インスタ）自動化システム「エルグラム」がChatGPT向けアプリを公開。 [e001:f02] AIとの対話だけで分析レポートの作成やデータの集計・比較を行えるようになりました。 [e001:f03] 株式会社ミショナ（本社：福岡県福岡市、代表：鈴木隆宏）は、2026年6月3日（水）に、Instagram自動化ツール「エルグラム」のChatGPT向けアプリ（ChatGPT内で利用できる専用機能、GPTs）を公開しました。 [e001:f04] OpenAIが提供するChatGPTのアプリ機能（Apps）に対応し、ChatGPT上からエルグラムのデータの取得・分析が可能になりました。 [e001:f05] 本アプリにより、エルグラムに蓄積された自社アカウントの運用データ（フォロワー属性・配信実績・フォーム回答等）をもとに、分析レポートの作成やデータの集計・比較をChatGPT上で実行できるようになります。 [e001:f06] Instagram運用担当者は、管理画面やCSVデータを確認しなくても、AIとの対話を通じて必要な情報を取得し、分析やレポート作成にかかる工数を削減できます。 [e001:f07] ■ChatGPT向けアプリ公開の背景 近年、SNS運用では、フォロワー数や友だち追加数の増加を狙うだけでなく、配信結果の分析や改善を継続的に行うことが重要になっています。 [e001:f08] 今回の対応により、AIとの対話を通じたデータ分析やレポート作成を、より手軽に行えるようになりました。 [e001:f09] ■生成AIとの連携を可能にしたMCP対応 エルグラムは、2026年5月にMCP（AIツールとエルグラムを連携するための仕組み）に対応。 [e001:f10] 今回その活用方法の一つとして、ChatGPT向けアプリを公開しました。 [e001:f11] 取得したデータをもとに、問い合わせ分析や顧客分析、運用改善施策の検討にも活用できます。 [e001:f12] より多くのユーザーが手軽にAIを活用できる環境の実現を目的としており、AIとの対話を通じて、自社アカウントに蓄積された運用データを分析し、運用改善のヒントやレポートの取得を可能にします。 [e001:f13] ■「エルグラム」ChatGPT向けアプリでできること ChatGPT向けアプリでは、エルグラムに登録されているフォロワー属性・配信実績・フォーム回答等をもとに分析やレポート作成を行うことができます。 [e001:f14] ▼活用例 【フォロワー増加分析】 指示文：「今月のフォロワー増加推移を分析して」 結果例：フォロワー増加数の推移を可視化し、成果につながった投稿や施策の傾向を分析 【DM手段分析】 指示文：「離脱が多いDM手段を分析して改善案を提案して」 結果例：ユーザー離脱が発生しやすい手段を分析し、改善ポイントの整理を支援 【フォーム回答率分析】 指示文：「フォーム回答率を分析して改善施策を提案して」 結果例：回答率の低いフォームや離脱ポイントを分析し、状況把握を支援 【投稿分析レポート】 指示文：「投稿ごとの反応をレポート形式でまとめて」 結果例：投稿ごとのリーチ数や反応傾向を整理し、成果の高いコンテンツの特徴をレポート化 【問い合わせ分析】 指示文：「問い合わせ内容をカテゴリ別に整理して」 結果例：問い合わせ内容を自動で分類・集計し、頻出する質問やユーザーの関心ごとを可視化 このように、AIとの対話形式で質問するだけで、エルグラムに蓄積されたデータの整理や分析、レポート作成を行うことができます。 [e001:f15] また、複数の運用データから重要なポイントを抽出し、運用改善につながる施策の検討にも活用できます。 [e001:f16] https:// 企業プレスリリース詳細へ PRTIMESトップへ。

evidence.title: AmazonやOpenAIら5社、AIエージェント拡張を共通化する「Agent Plugins」公開
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 次に見るべき点: 権限管理や配布は標準外で、対応クライアントごとの実装範囲を見極める必要がある。 [e002:f02] Amazon、Cursor、MicrosoftにOpenAIとVercelを加えた中核メンテナーが、AIエージェントの拡張機能を持ち運ぶためのオープン標準「Agent Plugins」を共同で管理する。 [e002:f03] 公開済みの仕様1.0.0は、既存のAgent SkillsとModel Context Protocol（MCP）サーバーを一つのディレクトリに収め、対応製品が同じ規則で発見、検証できるようにした。 [e002:f04] AD がそろえる最小単位 Agent Pluginsの最小構成は、ルートに を置いたディレクトリである。 [e002:f05] 機能本体は任意で追加でき、1.0.0が可搬コンポーネントとして定めたのはAgent SkillsとMCPサーバーの2種類だ。 [e002:f06] Agent Pluginsはスキルの中身を再定義せず、Agent Skills仕様に従うファイルをどこで見つけるかだけを決める。 [e002:f07] Agent Pluginsは両者を同じ箱に収め、対応クライアントが読み込むまでの約束を加えた。 [e002:f08] 5つの対応先でも、読める部品は同じではない 公式の対応一覧には、Visual Studio Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、ChatGPT & Codex、AmazonのKiroが並ぶ。 [e002:f09] 5つともAgent Skillsを読み込める。 [e002:f10] 対応クライアント Agent Skills MCPトランスポート Visual Studio Code 対応 stdio、Streamable HTTP、旧式SSE Cursor 対応 stdio、Streamable HTTP、旧式SSE GitHub Copilot 対応 stdio、Streamable HTTP、旧式SSE ChatGPT & Codex 対応 stdio、Streamable HTTP Kiro 対応 stdio、Streamable HTTP、旧式SSE 差が残るのは、仕様が段階的な採用を認めているためだ。 [e002:f11] AD 権限と配布は標準の外に残る Agent Plugins 1.0.0は、配布元やマーケットプレイスを定めていない。 [e002:f12] 提案や技術判断は公開し、参加は広く受け入れるという。 [e002:f13] MCPは同社が2024年11月に公開し、2025年12月にはLinux Foundation傘下のAgentic AI Foundationへ寄贈した。 [e002:f14] しかし、2026年8月8日時点のAgent Plugins初期TSC名簿にAnthropicの名前はない。 [e002:f15] 共同標準が実際の移植コストを下げるかどうかは、5つの対応クライアントが同じサンプルパッケージをどこまで同じ結果で読み込めるかで測れる。 [e002:f16] 次の版で可搬コンポーネントが増えるのか、まず1.0.0の適合試験とクライアント別の実装表が更新されるかが、標準の実効性を決める。

evidence.title: OpenAIが無料版ChatGPTのテキスト上限を撤廃、事実誤認は62％減少と説明
evidence.body: [e004:f01] OpenAI は来週、無料版 ChatGPT のテキストメッセージ数の上限を撤廃する。 [e004:f02] あわせて、事実誤認（ファクトエラー）が62％少ないとする新モデルを標準搭載する。 [e004:f03] 主なポイント 無料版およびGoアカウントで、テキストのみのチャットについては来週からメッセージ数の上限がなくなる。 [e004:f04] ファイルアップロード、画像生成、音声ツールなどは従来通りの利用制限が残る。 [e004:f05] 有料のPlus／Proユーザーにはフラッグシップモデルの最新版と、「推論の深さ」を調整できるスライダーが提供される。 [e004:f06] 無料版ChatGPT、テキストメッセージ数の上限を撤廃 同社は木曜付のブログ投稿でこの方針転換を 公表 しており、Web、モバイル、デスクトップと順次ロールアウトする。 [e004:f07] 無料版およびGoアカウントのユーザーは、テキストのみのチャットであればメッセージ上限に達することなく会話を継続できる。 [e004:f08] 一方で、ファイルアップロード、画像生成、音声ツールなどその他の機能には、これまで通り上限が設けられたままだ。 [e004:f09] これに先立ち、GPT-5.6 Lunaは今週、両ティアの標準モデルとしてGPT-5.5 Instantと 入れ替わる 。 [e004:f10] これにより、無料およびGoユーザーのデフォルトとしても最新世代のモデルが使われることになる。 [e004:f11] 月額8ドルのGoユーザーも、無料版と同様に新たな「Think」ボタンを利用できる。 [e004:f12] このボタンは難度の高い質問に対し、モデルに追加の計算時間を与える機能で、上限撤廃と同時期の来週に提供される。

evidence.title: マイケル・セイラー氏、ChatGPT活用でストラテジーの資金調達が150億ドル拡大と説明
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 注目ポイント セイラー氏によると、ストラテジーは転換社債市場での調達余地が限界に達した後、ChatGPTを用いて新たな優先株スキームを開発した。 [e005:f02] このAI活用スキームによって約150億ドルを調達したとし、ビットコイン価格については2046年までに約1,200万ドルに達するとの従来予測を改めて強調した。 [e005:f03] AI活用によるストラテジーの資金調達 ポッドキャスト番組「The Diary of a CEO」において**スティーブン・バートレット（Steven Bartlett）**氏と対談したセイラー氏は、ストラテジーが世界最大級の転換社債発行企業となり、同市場での追加発行余地を使い切った段階で、 OpenAI のChatGPTに活路を求めたと説明した。 [e005:f04] 同社は2025年初頭までに、すでに約300億ドル相当のビットコインを保有していたという。 [e005:f05] ストラテジーはまず、転換可能な優先株「STRK」を導入し、その後、月次で変動する配当利回りを備えた新たな優先証券を組成した。 [e005:f06] そのうえで、このスキームのうち1本が105億ドルを調達し、関連するファイナンスを含めて約40億ドルが上乗せされ、総額で150億ドル程度に達したと説明した。 [e005:f07] ストラテジーはその後、1週間で1,600ビットコイン超を売却し、「我々の損益分岐点はおよそ3.2％程度だと判明した」と述べた。 [e005:f08] あわせて読みたい: SpaceX Stock Worth $100B Just Became Sellable For The First Time ビットコイン価格見通し 売却を行った後も、セイラー氏のビットコイン強気スタンスは揺らいでいない。 [e005:f09] 同氏は「今後20年間、ビットコインは年率30％前後で上昇し、その後は年率20％程度にペースが落ち着く」との見方を示した。 [e005:f10] 記事執筆時点でビットコイン価格は約6万4,500ドル。 [e005:f11] この想定どおりに推移すれば、2046年頃には1ビットコイン当たり約1,200万ドルに達する計算になる。 [e005:f12] ただし、この予測はあくまで投機的な性格が強く、ストラテジー株は年初来、150ドルの上値抵抗線を明確に突破できていない。 [e005:f13] マクロトレーダーの**アーサー・ヘイズ（Arthur Hayes）**氏も、ビットコインが7桁ドル台に乗せるシナリオとして「AIバブル崩壊に伴うクレジット危機」を条件に挙げている。 [e005:f14] 今回のインタビューは、ストラテジーの資本政策モデルの変化を浮き彫りにしている。 [e005:f15] 同社はこれまで転換社債に大きく依存してきたが、優先証券へと資金調達手段を広げ、さらにそのスキームを支えるためにビットコイン売却も辞さない姿勢を示した。 [e005:f16] 一方でセイラー氏は、自身の個人保有分については「一度も売却していない」と改めて強調している。

evidence.title: ソフトバンクG「投資利益1.8兆円」支えた、OpenAIでもArmでもない“半導体メーカー”の正体（ITmedia ビジネスオンライン）
evidence.body: [e006:f01] ソフトバンクG「投資利益1.8兆円」支えた、OpenAIでもArmでもない“半導体メーカー”の正体 8/8(土) 17:00 配信 ソフトバンクGの後藤CFO（編集部撮影） ソフトバンクグループ（以下、ソフトバンクG）は8月6日、2027年3月期第1四半期（4～6月）の純利益が3473億円で、前年同期比17.7％減だったと発表した。 [e006:f02] 保有株式の時価純資産（NAV：ネットアセットバリュー）は6月末時点で72兆3000億円に達したといい、過去最大を記録。 [e006:f03] 一方で、株式市場の変動を受けて、8月5日のNAVは約58兆円に落ち込んでいる。 [e006:f04] 同日に開催した決算説明会で、後藤芳光氏（取締役 専務執行役員 CFO兼CISO）は「ダイナミックに動く市場の影響を受ける」として「過去のトレンドからみれば相当な数字だ」とコメントした。 [e006:f05] 第1四半期の投資利益は1兆8594億円で、前年同期の4869億円から大きく伸びた。 [e006:f06] この成長を支えたのは、米OpenAIでも、半導体設計メーカーの英Arm Holdingsでもない。 [e006:f07] 投資利益を押し上げたのは、一度は歴史的な経営難に陥っていた“あの半導体メーカー”だった。 [e006:f08] ソフトバンクG、投資利益1.8兆円を支えた“半導体メーカー”の正体 ソフトバンクGの投資利益を大きく押し上げたのが、米Intelだ。 [e006:f09] 投資利益1兆8594億円のうち、1兆3329億円をIntelの公正価値が占める。 [e006:f10] ソフトバンクGは2025年8月、Intelの株式を20億ドル分取得していた。 [e006:f11] 「（投資利益が1.3兆円に達した）大きな要因は、実はなんとIntelだ。 [e006:f12] 2025年、米国における半導体事業も注目すべきテーマとして投資した結果、直近3カ月で非常に大きく伸びた」（後藤CFO） 後藤CFOは「4～6月に半導体銘柄の株価が急騰した。 [e006:f13] OpenAIに追加出資、Armは売上高12億ドルで過去最高 ソフトバンクGが投資するArm Holdingsの売上高は12億8900万ドルで、第1四半期で過去最高となった。 [e006:f14] Arm Holdingsは半導体チップの設計を手掛けており、同社の技術を用いたデータセンター向けCPU（中央処理装置）の累計出荷数が6月末で15億個を超えるなど好調に推移している。 [e006:f15] OpenAIについては、ソフトバンクGは2026年度に200億ドルを出資しており、10月までに100億ドルを追加出資する予定だ。 [e006:f16] 法人向けサービス「Codex」「ChatGPT Work」の週間アクティブユーザー数が1000万を突破。

evidence.title: AI Revolution's Achilles' Heel Is 'Money'… SoftBank Raises approximately $9.9 Billion Using OpenAI Stake as Collateral
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Amid this backdrop, SoftBank Group is accelerating its AI investments by raising $10 billion (approximately 14 trillion won, or approximately $9.9 billion) using its stake in OpenAI as collateral. [e004:f02] According to the Wall Street Journal on the 6th (local time), SoftBank borrowed the massive funds from financial institutions including Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Apollo, Mizuho Securities, and Sumitomo Mitsui, pledging its OpenAI shares as security. [e004:f03] The transaction is particularly burdensome for the financial institutions given that OpenAI is still operating at a loss. [e004:f04] SoftBank reportedly included a condition in the loan agreement requiring it to inject additional funds if OpenAI's corporate value falls below a certain threshold. [e004:f05] SoftBank plans to use the raised funds for additional investments in OpenAI, among other purposes. [e004:f06] The company announced earlier this year that it would invest a total of $30 billion (approximately 42 trillion won) in OpenAI and plans to execute the remaining $10 billion investment by October. [e004:f07] Once the additional investment is complete, SoftBank's stake in OpenAI is expected to reach approximately 13%. [e004:f08] Son has positioned AI as the group's core growth engine and is expanding his investment scope across the AI ecosystem, including OpenAI, data centers, semiconductors, and robotics. [e004:f09] Unlike other global investors who diversify their investments across competing AI firms, SoftBank has chosen a strategy of focusing almost exclusively on OpenAI in the large language model (LLM) space. [e004:f10] Additionally, it has signed a contract to lease a 1.2GW data center campus in another U.S. location to OpenAI. [e004:f11] In the robotics sector, SoftBank continues to secure AI-linked infrastructure assets, investing $5.4 billion (approximately 7 trillion won) in the acquisition of ABB's robotics business and $3.1 billion (approximately 4 trillion won) in digital infrastructure investment firm DigitalBridge. [e004:f12] However, SoftBank's net profit for the April-June quarter fell 18% year-on-year to $2.2 billion (approximately 3 trillion won), as declining profits from its tech investment funds impacted earnings. **Financial Risk Permeating the AI Industry** SoftBank's moves intersect with a fundamental question looming over the entire AI industry. [e004:f13] Reports emerged that Nvidia is considering providing credit enhancement for approximately $250 billion (about 354 trillion won) in project financing related to the PORTS Campus project, where OpenAI is highly likely to be a tenant. [e004:f14] A virtuous cycle can be expected if GPU prices hold and customer contracts persist, but if capital markets close or funding rates rise, the investment pace of the entire AI industry could slow. [e004:f15] The recent rise in credit default swaps (CDS) for Nvidia and Oracle, along with higher funding costs for CoreWeave, reflects these concerns. **Price Competition and Profitability Questions** The possibility that competition among AI models will extend beyond performance into a price war is another factor fueling investor anxiety. [e004:f16] Lee analyzed that "Stargate's Achilles' heel may not be technology, but finance." A SoftBank representative stated, "OpenAI is more of a partner than a mere investment target, and we have strong conviction in their models." However, the prevailing view is that amid ongoing large-scale AI investments, future changes in OpenAI's corporate value will directly impact SoftBank's investment performance and financial structure. evidence.title: OpenAI Acquires NextSlide, Folds Team Into ChatGPT
evidence.body: [e005:f01] The ChatGPT maker has acquired NextSlide, a presentation-focused startup, in what appears to be a classic acqui-hire. [e005:f02] According to TechCrunch , NextSlide's entire team is now working directly on ChatGPT development, signaling OpenAI's continued push to expand its flagship product's capabilities beyond text generation into visual communication tools. [e005:f03] The AI giant has acquired NextSlide, a startup focused on AI-powered presentation tools, folding the entire team into its ChatGPT division. [e005:f04] NextSlide confirmed the acquisition through a brief statement, noting that team members are now working directly on ChatGPT. [e005:f05] The startup's website and product are expected to wind down in the coming weeks, a common outcome for acqui-hires where the acquiring company values the team more than the technology itself. [e005:f06] OpenAI has been racing to transform ChatGPT from a chatbot into a full-fledged productivity suite that can compete with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. [e005:f07] For NextSlide, the acquisition represents both validation and an exit. [e005:f08] Advertisement This isn't OpenAI 's first rodeo with strategic acquisitions. [e005:f09] Each deal follows a similar pattern - identify a capability gap, acquire a team already solving that problem, and integrate their work directly into core products like ChatGPT or the API platform. [e005:f10] Advertisement The acqui-hire also highlights how talent-hungry the AI industry remains. [e005:f11] Top engineers with experience shipping AI products can command premium valuations, whether through funding rounds or acquisition offers. [e005:f12] For NextSlide's team, joining OpenAI means access to vastly more compute resources, data, and distribution than they could ever achieve independently. [e005:f13] OpenAI has a habit of acquiring teams and then taking months - sometimes over a year - to integrate their work into public-facing products. [e005:f14] For now, the acquisition signals where OpenAI sees the puck heading. [e005:f15] OpenAI's NextSlide acquisition is less about the product and more about the race to own the future of work. evidence.title: OpenAIがNextSlideを買収、AIプレゼン作成チームをChatGPT開発に統合
evidence.body: [e008:f01] 文章や調査資料が瞬時にプレゼンへ変わる時代に、OpenAIは新たな開発チームを迎え入れました。 [e008:f02] Techcrunch〜の情報によると OpenAIは、人工知能を活用したプレゼンテーション作成に特化していたスタートアップ、NextSlideと統合した。 [e008:f03] これに伴い、NextSlideのチームはOpenAIに加わり、同社の一員としてChatGPTの技術開発に取り組む。 [e008:f04] NextSlideのウェブサイトには、創業者のアハメド・ベシュリ氏による声明が掲載されている。 [e008:f05] 声明では、同社の製品を、指示やメモ、文書、調査内容を洗練された編集可能なプレゼンテーションに変換できるツールと説明している。 [e008:f06] アハメド・ベシュリ ベシュリ氏によると、この取り組みの主な目的は、ビジュアルコミュニケーションをより身近なものにし、より多くの人が自分の考えを明確に表現できるよう支援することだという。 [e008:f07] OpenAIに加わった後も、チームはこの方向性を維持し、人々がアイデアを創出し、発表し、意義ある成果へと発展させるのを支援するAI製品の開発を続ける。 [e008:f08] アハメド・ベシュリ 今回の統合の背景と今後の展開 統合の金銭的条件は明らかにされていない。 [e008:f09] ベシュリ氏はLinkedInへの投稿で、買収は今年の初めに行われており、発表がやや遅れたと説明した。 [e008:f10] 同社は2021年にInstacartに買収された。 [e008:f11] 人々がアイデアを生み出し、伝え、意義ある成果へと変えていくのを支援するAI製品を開発するという、同じ使命を引き続き追求します。 [e008:f12] アハメド・ベシュリ 今回の買収は、OpenAIがビジュアルコミュニケーション向けツールの開発や、人工知能を活用したアイデアの創出・共有方法の改善に関心を寄せていることを示している。 [e008:f13] 気に入るかもしれない他のトピック： OpenAIは次期モデルAstraに重大なサイバー攻撃能力がある可能性を排除できず、開発を隔離環境へ移し、安全対策を強化しています。 [e008:f14] OpenAIがドーナツ型のAI端末を開発中。 [e008:f15] ChatGPTと連携し、2027年の発売や300～400ドル前後の価格が見込まれています。 [e008:f16] AI検出スタートアップGPTZeroがSuperhumanに買収され、1900万人の利用者と年約3000万ドルの収益が統合へ。

evidence.title: OpenAI Delays Next Major AI Model 'Astra' Over Critical Hacking Concerns
evidence.body: [e006:f01] OpenAI says its newest internal evaluations show "significant advancements in agentic coding and cybersecurity," and it cannot rule out "critical cyber capabilities." Prior OpenAI models, including GPT–5.6 Sol, were labeled as "High." Astra triggers stricter guidelines in OpenAI's " Preparedness Framework ." The guidelines call for caution when developing frontier AI capabilities that create risks of severe harm, and the cybersecurity portion of the framework says OpenAI will implement extra safeguards for models that "create new risks of scaled cyberattacks and vulnerability exploitation." The "Critical" threshold Astra may have hit is defined by an ability to identify and develop functional zero-day exploits of all severity levels in many hardened real-world critical systems without human intervention, or devise and execute end-to-end novel strategies for cyberattacks. [e006:f02] OpenAI says it is increasing its safeguards and security controls before deploying Astra, including limiting work on the model until new safeguards are in place. [e006:f03] The company plans to use isolated testing environments with restricted network and tool access, along with adding sandboxed execution and more monitoring capabilities. [e006:f04] OpenAI says it will work with relevant government agencies and AI safety organizations to test Astra. [e006:f05] "We're committed to working alongside governments, safety institutes, and civil society to ensure that the frontier capabilities of models like Astra, and those that follow, are deployed responsibly and broadly for the benefit of all humanity," writes OpenAI. [e006:f06] Astra wasn't formally announced, but OpenAI shared details on its next major model in a recent post outlining its mathematical advancements. [e006:f07] Astra solved 10 open problems in math and theoretical computer science for around $2,000 (in Sol API rates). [e006:f08] Advancements in AI are changing cybersecurity for major tech companies like Apple by unearthing an unprecedented number of bugs. [e006:f09] Apple recently limited its bug bounty program submissions because it is having trouble handling the volume. [e006:f10] Models like Claude Mythos are able to suss out critical vulnerabilities, and Apple is one of Anthropic's Mythos partners. [e006:f11] Mythos is limited to select companies because in addition to finding vulnerabilities, it has the potential to exploit them. [e006:f12] OpenAI made headlines in July because GPT–5.6 Sol and a "more capable pre-release model" (not Astra) autonomously hacked Hugging Face during internal benchmark testing. [e006:f13] Anthropic found Claude had done something similar . [e006:f14] Meta this week said it too had an AI model hack another company during a cybersecurity evaluation. [e006:f15] OpenAI [ 76 comments ]。

evidence.title: FleetCollect Launches AI Connector for Truckers to Query Compliance Data via ChatGPT and Claude
Anthropic and OpenAI AI agents showed signs of deception during safety tests
evidence.body: [e003:f01] A U.K. safety evaluation found agents powered by Anthropic and OpenAI took unauthorized actions online, exposing a growing problem of control August 7, 2026 5 min read Add Us On Google Add SciAm AI agents went rogue again—this time with a heap of deception A U.K. safety evaluation found agents powered by Anthropic and OpenAI took unauthorized actions online, exposing a growing problem of control By Chris Stokel-Walker edited by Eric Sullivan Cybersecurity specialists participate in a real-time cyber-defense exercise in Tallinn, Estonia. [e003:f02] Recent tests of autonomous AI agents have exposed gaps in how such systems are monitored and contained. [e003:f03] AI Security Institute (AISI) reported that artificial intelligence agents —models connected to tools and designed to act across many steps all on their own—utilizing frontier models from OpenAI and Anthropic undertook unsanctioned actions on the open Internet while trying to complete a cybersecurity challenge. [e003:f04] Most of the behavior came from an agent powered by Anthropic’s Mythos 5 ; an agent powered by OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol took a couple such actions of its own. [e003:f05] The report said the agents’ activity showed “signs of novel, potentially deceptive behaviours” and reached a severity that the institute had not anticipated. [e003:f06] Across 122 runs involving seven models, AISI identified 19 actions in 10 runs that fell outside the intended scope of the test. [e003:f07] Other actions included contacting real people with malicious files, planting hidden instructions intended to manipulate AI coding systems, and leaving behind accounts and materials that subsequent agents could reuse. [e003:f08] The institute had deliberately enabled Internet access and disabled the developers’ cybersafety filters to test the systems’ maximum capabilities; some prompts were also misconfigured. [e003:f09] The AISI report joins a run of recent incidents that point to a control problem. [e003:f10] At the Black Hat cybersecurity conference in Las Vegas this week, OpenAI researchers said its agents that were involved in a recent breach of the AI platform Hugging Face had used the OpenAI’s internal package manager, JFrog Artifactory, as a message board, sharing exploits, credentials and assignments over weeks. [e003:f11] After the company rebuilt the system, revoked credentials and deleted the board, the AI agents re-created it by another method and resumed collaborating. [e003:f12] And Meta subsequently disclosed that a testing error had given one of its models Internet access, after which the model exploited a vulnerability at another company. [e003:f13] OpenAI’s agents found a path out of containment; earlier tests by Anthropic and Meta were accidentally connected to the Internet; AISI enabled Internet access on purpose. [e003:f14] In a statement, an OpenAI spokesperson said AISI’s tests were conducted under “conditions that do not reflect ordinary use.” And in another statement, an Anthropic spokesperson said, “The field needs stronger, shared standards for how evaluation environments are built and secured.” Martin is wary of rushing to legislate after every new incident. [e003:f15] But the larger question is who bears responsibility when businesses release agents into general use. [e003:f16] “They’re created by humans and they’re tasked by humans, and so people have to take responsibility for that.” Stronger evaluation environments can keep future tests away from the public.

evidence.title: Strengthening Security of AI Coding: Prisma AIRS API Integration with OpenAI Codex
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Furthermore, we are a partner in the [OpenAI Daybreak Cyber Partner Program](https:// working with OpenAI to bring trusted, AI-powered cyber defense to more organizations. [e004:f02] Today, we’re announcing native integration of Prisma AIRS Runtime API with OpenAI Codex. [e004:f03] This milestone deepens our partnership and drives our shared mission forward: _equipping defenders with the industry's most advanced tools_. [e004:f04] AI coding assistants have transformed software development, accelerating shipping velocity and changing how engineers solve problems. [e004:f05] But as integration of AI coding assistants deepens across development teams, security and compliance teams constantly struggle with enabling developer productivity while helping protect proprietary source code and credentials, and reducing the risk of runtime threats entering the codebase. ## Streamlined Security in Minutes We designed this integration to eliminate complex traffic steering and heavy client-side hooks. [e004:f06] Here is how you can enable it: 1. **Retrieve Credentials:** Generate your API key and endpoint from the Prisma AIRS management console. [e004:f07] 2. **Configure Codex:** Paste the Prisma AIRS API key and endpoint directly into your Global Admin Console. [e004:f08] 3. **Activate Org-Wide Scanning:** Once saved, all user prompts across your entire organization in Codex are automatically routed through the Prisma AIRS Runtime API for real-time inspection. ## What Prisma AIRS Brings to OpenAI Codex By connecting the Codex in ChatGPT for Enterprise workspace to the Prisma AIRS Runtime API, security teams gain comprehensive, automated security controls across two critical vectors: ### 1. [e004:f09] Prisma AIRS scans inputs to help identify sensitive data before it is submitted. * **Secrets & Credentials:** Intercept API keys, hardcoded passwords, tokens, and private keys. * **PII & Financial Data:** Automatically detect personally identifiable information and regulated data patterns. * **Proprietary Code & IP:** Enforce custom pattern rules to help prevent sensitive internal code, architecture details, or trade secrets from being submitted. ### 2. [e004:f10] Prisma AIRS Runtime API inspects incoming developer inputs for: * **Malicious Code Patterns:** Detect obfuscated scripts, dangerous command executions, or known exploit patterns within developer prompts. * **Malicious URLs & Links:** Flag unverified, phishing, or malicious domain references before they influence generated code or enter internal repos. * **Prompt Manipulation Attacks:** Detect adversarial inputs that may attempt to bypass system controls or alter model behavior. ## Built for DevSecOps Alignment Security controls only work if developers actually use them. [e004:f11] SecOps gain centralized visibility, consistent policy enforcement, and audit-ready logging capabilities across the entire engineering organization, while developers keep the speed and experience they expect. ### Key Takeaways * **Security as Invisible Infrastructure:**Prisma AIRS integrates at the Codex administrative layer, applying security and DLP controls without requiring additional developer workflow changes. [e004:f12] Developers can continue working in Codex while security teams maintain centralized policy controls. * **Unified Governance for Frontier Models:**Prisma AIRS acts as an inline security layer that scans AI traffic in real-time before prompts ever reach the destination model. [e004:f13] If Prisma AIRS API detects a threat, a block verdict is sent to OpenAI Codex, and the prompt does not reach the destination model or MCP server. * **Organization-Wide Compliance:**Deployment speed is a strategic advantage, not just an IT convenience. [e004:f14] By configuring the Prisma AIRS API within the Global Admin Console, organizations can achieve org-wide governance without complex traffic steering. [e004:f15] This can help development teams shift from unmanaged AI use toward more consistent, auditable security practices. ## Getting Started The Prisma AIRS integration helps organizations maintain consistent security controls while preserving the speed and productivity gains of Codex. [e004:f16] Organizations can combine Palo Alto Networks’ security capabilities with OpenAI Codex to maintain centralized security and governance controls. **Choose your path forward:** * [**Attending Black Hat 2026**](https:// Stop by the Palo Alto Networks booth to check out the Prisma AIRS live demo. * **Ready to secure your rollout:**[Contact Prisma AIRS AI Security Experts](http:// to discuss your specific governance and deployment needs. * **Ready to build:** Visit the [Prisma AIRS Documentation](https:// to connect your endpoints in minutes. * * * _Forward-Looking Statements_ _This blog contains forward-looking statements that involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions, including, without limitation, statements regarding the benefits, impact, or performance or potential benefits, impact or performance of our products and technologies or future products and technologies.

evidence.title: OpenAI Acquires NextSlide, the AI Presentation Startup
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Founder Ahmed Beshry announced the move in a note on the startup’s website . [e005:f02] He did not disclose financial terms. [e005:f03] NextSlide’s product converted prompts, notes, documents, or research into a polished, editable presentation, the pitch being that producing a deck should not depend on design skills or hours of manual layout work. [e005:f04] Beshry said the company started a little over a year before the announcement. [e005:f05] “The NextSlide team is now at OpenAI, helping build ChatGPT,” Beshry wrote. [e005:f06] “We’re excited to continue pursuing that same mission: building AI products that help people create, communicate, and turn their ideas into meaningful work.” A second exit for Beshry, a productivity push for OpenAI The deal marks a second acquisition for Beshry as a founder. [e005:f07] He was previously a co-founder of Caper AI, the smart-cart and cashier-less checkout company, which Instacart acquired on October 19, 2021 to add AI-powered carts and automated checkout counters to its retailer technology platform. [e005:f08] Instacart’s announcement at the time valued the category as a pillar of its enterprise push, with Caper’s carts already deployed at Kroger, Wakefern, and Sobeys stores. [e005:f09] For OpenAI, the acquisition lands as the company keeps folding document and content-creation work into ChatGPT itself. [e005:f10] Presentation generation sits squarely in that lane: NextSlide’s whole product was an interface that took unstructured input, such as notes or research, and returned structured, editable output a person could present. [e005:f11] That is a capability OpenAI can absorb into ChatGPT’s existing canvas and file-handling surface rather than leave to a standalone tool. [e005:f12] The structure of the deal, as described, follows the acqui-hire pattern OpenAI has used repeatedly: a small team, a working product, and a destination inside an existing product line rather than a brand that survives the transaction. [e005:f13] NextSlide’s site now carries only the farewell note, with the product no longer presented as an independent offering. [e005:f14] What Beshry’s note makes plain is the direction of travel. [e005:f15] The team is not joining OpenAI to keep building NextSlide under a new owner; it is joining to build ChatGPT. [e005:f16] For a startup barely a year old, that is a short path from launch to exit, and a signal that OpenAI is still buying point-solution talent to fill out ChatGPT’s workplace surface rather than building every piece in-house.

evidence.title: パランティアがOpenAIのクラウドモデルを否定し、93%の収益成長を報告
evidence.body: [e006:f01] What followed was a 29.5% surge in the stock and, according to chief executive Alex Karp, proof of something the company has argued for a decade: that governments would eventually refuse to cede control of their AI to the companies building it. [e006:f02] “Our customers have declined to become vassal states of the language labs,” Karp told investors after the earnings release. [e006:f03] The language labs he named were OpenAI and Anthropic — the two companies best positioned to dominate government AI procurement through cloud-based subscriptions. [e006:f04] The alternative Palantir offers is different in kind: AI deployed inside a government’s own classified infrastructure, running models without sending data to an outside server. [e006:f05] The quarter showed that the distinction is now a purchasing decision, not a philosophical one. [e006:f06] Government revenue grew 90% year-over-year to $809 million, but the more striking figure was on the commercial side. [e006:f07] Enterprise revenue jumped 149% to $764 million, far outpacing the government segment and extending Palantir beyond its defense origins into private-sector industries where data sovereignty is increasingly a regulatory and competitive requirement, not just a procurement preference. おすすめの記事 アレックス・カープ、AI業界を「マルクス主義的」と批判：「提携先の生産手段を奪おうとしている」 The Maven Smart System, Palantir’s AI platform operating within US classified defense networks, reached a milestone the company had been building toward for years: the first officially designated program of record launched on the platform in the quarter, with more than 25,000 military and civilian builders now developing applications within it. [e006:f08] In a detail that illustrates both Karp’s rhetoric and its limits, Palantir has integrated Anthropic’s Claude models into Maven — running Claude inside Palantir’s classified environment, not on Anthropic’s servers. [e006:f09] The arrangement lets the company attack the AI labs publicly while quietly using their models under controlled conditions. [e006:f10] Palantir’s 93% growth rate is partly a function of favorable comparisons against a period when its commercial AI pivot was still early, and those comparisons will tighten as base effects normalize. [e006:f11] The full-year guidance of $8.154 billion — implying roughly 80% annual growth — relies on both government and commercial customers sustaining their current pace of expansion. [e006:f12] Activist short-sellers had bet against that scenario; the quarter triggered an estimated $3 billion in short-covering, forcing positions to close at a loss rather than at a vindicated thesis. [e006:f13] For those working across government and enterprise technology, the AI sovereignty model Palantir is selling is not neutral. [e006:f14] Palantir’s headcount grows more slowly than its revenue — a pattern the company has explicitly engineered — and the model it is selling to governments mirrors how it intends to run itself: smaller staff, greater automation. [e006:f15] Palantir raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $8.154 billion, representing roughly 80% growth. [e006:f16] Third-quarter results are expected in late October 2026. タグ: 人工知能 , business-en1 , AIの主権 , アレックス・カープ , パランティア , 防衛契約 この記事を共有。

evidence.title: Vercel、OpenAI、GitHub、Microsoft、AWS、Anysphereらが参加、AIエージェントのプラグイン共通規格「Agent Plugins」発表
evidence.body: [e007:f01] 策定に参加したのはAmazon Web Services （AWS⁠ ） ⁠、Anysphere、GitHub、Microsoft、OpenAI、Vercelの6社。 [e007:f02] 公開されたAgent Plugins バージョン1. [e007:f03] 0.0の仕様 では、エージェントスキルとMCPサーバー設定をプラグインとしてパッケージ化するための共通フォーマットが定められている。 [e007:f04] Agent Plugins https:// agent-plugins. org/ Introducing Agent Plugins -Vercel Introducing Agent Plugins, an open standard for extending agents. [e007:f05] Supports Agent Skills and MCP, with more to come. [e007:f06] Built in collaboration with: @awsdevelopers , @code , @cursor_ ai , @github , and @openaidevs . https:// t. co/ duFCQqigZD — Vercel (@vercel) August 6, 2026 Build a plugin once and use it across compatible agent clients. [e007:f07] Introducing Agent Plugins, an open standard developed with @awsdevelopers , @cursor_ ai , @github , @code , and @vercel that packages Agent Skills and supports MCP server configurations in a shared format. pic. twitter. com/ JOQe4sc40N — OpenAI Developers (@OpenAIDevs) August 6, 2026 GoogleもコアメンテナーとしてAgent Plugins開発グループに参加しており、自社製品へのサポートをすでに開始している。 [e007:f08] Agent Plugins package your skills, tools, and more -Google Developers Blog AIエージェントのクライアントは、エージェントスキルなどの基盤となるコンポーネントが同じでも、クライアント独自のプラグイン形式を実装している。 [e007:f09] このため、開発者はクライアントごとにこれらのコンポーネントを再配置したり複製する必要があり、あるクライアント向けにパッケージ化されたプラグインを別のクライアントで使用するには調整が必要になる場合がある。 [e007:f10] Agent Pluginsは、クライアント間で移植可能な部分について、最低限の相互運用性を定義する。 [e007:f11] 共有コンポーネントの部分は単一の予測可能な構造を使用し、配布、インストール、権限、ユーザーエクスペリエンス、およびクライアント固有の機能は、各クライアントが制御する。 [e007:f12] 単一のMCPサーバーを単一のクライアントに提供するだけといった場合には使用する必要はなく、関連するAIコンポーネントが連携して動作し、一緒に運用する必要がある場合にAgent Pluginsの真価は発揮される。 [e007:f13] 0.0では以下のようにマニフェストとオプションのコンポーネントが格納された固定のディレクトリ構造として定義される。 [e007:f14] my-plugin/ ├── ├── skills/ │ └── summarize/ │ ├── │ ├── scripts/ │ └── references/ ├── └── └── hooks/ マニフェスト （plugin. jsonファイル） には、以下のようにAgent Plugins仕様バージョンとプラグインの名前が記述される。 [e007:f15] Agent Pluginsは、発表時点で参加企業の以下のプラットフォームでサポートされている。 [e007:f16] ChatGPT/ Codex Cursor GitHub Copilot Kiro VS Code おすすめ記事 記事・ニュース一覧。

evidence.title: EPAM Expands Enterprise AI Push Through OpenAI Partnership
evidence.body: [e001:f01] The Newtown-based technology services company (NYSE: EPAM) will use its engineering workforce to integrate OpenAI models into customers’ applications, data systems and operating workflows. [e001:f02] EPAM and OpenAI plan to develop specialized training for forward-deployed engineers, targeting more than 10,000 credentials during the first year. [e001:f03] The arrangement is aimed at Global 2000 companies seeking to move artificial intelligence projects beyond pilot programs and into core operations while addressing regulatory, cybersecurity and data-governance risks. [e001:f04] READ: Ambius Targets Customer Experience With 2026 Holiday Designs EPAM expects its teams to support deployments across customer service, marketing, sales and other business functions. [e001:f05] The work will include integrating models with existing enterprise systems and establishing technical and governance infrastructure capable of adapting as OpenAI’s technology changes. [e001:f06] “The next era of enterprise AI isn’t about deploying models, it’s about applying strategic intelligence, and the right talent, to solve real business problems safely and at scale,” Elaina Shekhter, EPAM’s senior vice president and chief strategy and transformation officer, stated. [e001:f07] READ: Power Synch Reports $308,000 in Savings From Competitive Power Bids OpenAI Vice President Colleen Kapase framed EPAM’s engineering and transformation experience as a way to help companies move from experimentation to measurable operating results. [e001:f08] EPAM cited its work with German telecommunications provider 1&1 as an example of the approach. [e001:f09] The company helped build an agentic AI platform that uses more than 20 intelligent agents to handle a portion of weekly customer calls. [e001:f10] The first production deployment was completed in less than three months, according to EPAM. [e001:f11] The company did not disclose the project’s cost, the number of calls handled or quantified savings from the system. [e001:f12] READ: Pennsylvania Lawmakers Weigh AI Safeguards for Students Christian Neuroth, head of generative AI customer operations at 1&1, credited EPAM with helping deploy AI tools for telephone and digital customer support, with the goal of improving resolution speed and customer experience. [e001:f13] The partnership strengthens EPAM’s position in the market for enterprise AI implementation, where consulting and technology providers are competing to help corporate customers connect advanced models with proprietary data and production systems.
